title: A handoff: one item of <app>.handoffs v1
description: An offer from the app that owns the collection to the app in `to`, which the person accepts or dismisses there. See handoffs.md.

payload.description: Extra fields in a shape the receiver documents. Receivers ignore fields they do not know.

accepted.description: True when the person already accepted the item in the sender (handoffs.md, rule 4). Missing or false: an ordinary offer.
